description: Defines interfaces, data structures, and classes for managing F1AP connection procedures between gNB-DU and CU-CP, including setup, reset, configuration update, and removal procedures.

classes.name: f1ap_connection_manager
classes.description: Abstract interface for managing F1AP connection procedures between DU and CU-CP, including setup, removal, reset, and configuration updates.

classes.name: f1ap_interface_update_notifier
classes.description: Interface for notifying the DU of CU-initiated F1AP interface management requests.

methods.name: connect_to_cu_cp
methods.description: Establishes connection between DU and CU-CP via F1-C interface.

methods.name: disconnect_from_cu_cp
methods.description: Disconnects DU from CU-CP after failed setup.

methods.name: handle_f1_setup_request
methods.description: Handles the F1 setup request procedure.

methods.name: is_f1_setup
methods.description: Checks if F1 interface setup with CU-CP is complete.
